method.locked05: Half-inning scoreless = 65% starting-pitcher season I2 scoreless rate + 35% opponent offense last-25 I2 scoreless rate. Full I2 Under 0.5 = top scoreless x bottom scoreless.
method.distributionExtension: For alternate run totals only, the same 65/35 weights are applied bucket-by-bucket to observed I2 run distributions (0,1,2,3,4+); full-inning distribution is the convolution of top and bottom distributions. This extension does not alter the locked 0.5 formula.
method.recentWindows: Pitcher last15/10/5 and offense last10 are diagnostics only and are not model inputs.
method.starterIdentity: Uses the already-frozen production starter MLB identity when available; MLB probable-pitcher is fallback only. This aligns inputs without changing the empirical formula.
